잘못되다.e: to go wrong; to be wrong
잘못되다.n: things or results turning out wrong
cf: to do wrong; to make a mistake

윗사람.n: anyone above you in age or rank, relative and spoken
cf: stiff word for a higher-ranked person in rules and reports

씻기다.e: to wash (someone else); to be washed away
씻기다.n: washing another person, like a child, or being washed away
cf: to wash one's hair; to close one's eyes
used for washing hair; also closing the eyes
casual, everyday word for washing clothes
everyday, washing your face, often in the morning
to wash off; to rinse; to cleanse
formal, cleaning dirt off vegetables, tools or wounds with water
to wash; to do the laundry; to launder
formal, laundry by machine or cleaning service
general: hands, body, fruit; alone often means washing up
